result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: the Company may terminate on 30 days’ notice, receives a functionally pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, and HDI may terminate for convenience only at term-end on 90 days’ notice. However, it goes beyond the playbook by permitting termination “in whole or in part” without defining partial-termination mechanics and by eliminating fees or penalties in connection with “any termination,” rather than only the Company’s convenience termination. That wording could affect remedies or amounts associated with termination for breach and therefore does not preserve unrelated commercial intent. Drafting is otherwise generally clear and professional.
